infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Fitaround uses your calendar to schedule workouts around your life.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Fitaround reads your calendar to schedule workouts around your life, and — only when you turn it on — adds your sessions to it.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Fitaround adds your scheduled workouts to your calendar when you turn that on.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Fitaround sends reminders before your scheduled workouts.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Fitaround sends reminders before your scheduled workouts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fitaround lets you attach progress photos to your measurements. Photos stay private to your account.

plugins.calendarPermission: Fitaround needs calendar access to schedule your workouts.
plugins.remindersPermission: Fitaround needs reminder access to send workout alerts.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Fitaround does not read any Health data.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Fitaround adds your completed workouts to Apple Health when you turn this on in Settings.
